notes.title: UPDATE: Good news, Verdansking queens, Call of Duty Black Ops 6 and Warzone season 3's new release date has been revealed, so we know when the iconic map's returning
notes.content: UPDATE (10/02/25, 3:50 PM GMT): Activision has now confirmed that Verdansk will be returning to Call of Duty: Warzone on April 3, with a fresh teaser showing off a bunch of long, romantic shots of soldiers fondling its soil and trying to make love to what looks like some tiling.
